title: The boast and the opened books
english: This was nothing other than boasting against the glory of God and exalting himself over the ruler set over those from Israel, as though that ruler could in no way benefit his own people. The books were opened (Daniel 7:10). For when the only Son came in the form that is ours, then the Father opened the books. He released those guilty of sins from judgment, and he permitted those who act courageously to be enrolled and numbered among the choirs above and to be held in remembrance. And what does it mean, “He reached as far as the Ancient of Days” (Daniel 7:13)? Is it in a spatial sense? Then how is this not foolish? Because the divine is not in a place, for it fills all things.
